record.question: Which of the following statements about the Police Establishment Board (PEB)is not correct according to the Mizoram Police Act, 2011?
options: The PEB is chaired by the Director General of Police and includes four other senior-most officers of the state police.
The PEB is responsible for recommending officers for postings to all positions in the ranks of Assistant/Deputy Superintendents and above, excluding the Director General of Police.
The PEB has the authority to appoint the Director General of Police.
The PEB examines complaints from police officers about being subjected to illegal orders and makes appropriate recommendations to the Director General of Police.
